decision.explanation: Document 0061 explicitly states the stadium was the home of Gençlerbirliği and used by Ankaraspor, while Document 0061 (d01) incorrectly asserts it was the home of Bursaspor; the fallible prior regarding Samsunspor refers to a different stadium in Samsun, not the Ankara 19 Mayıs Stadium described in the text.
